# KPOps

> Deploy Kafka pipelines to Kubernetes.

The documentation is versioned. Use the version matching the KPOps version of the project.

## Versions

- [main](https://bakdata.github.io/kpops/main/llms.txt): [full text](https://bakdata.github.io/kpops/main/llms-full.txt)
- [13.0 (latest)](https://bakdata.github.io/kpops/13.0/llms.txt): [full text](https://bakdata.github.io/kpops/13.0/llms-full.txt)
